description: Source code for onboarding pages and UI flows in the OpenClaw macOS application, including onboarding steps, permission requests, CLI installation, workspace setup, chat interface, and feature highlights.

methods.name: pageView
methods.description: Builds different onboarding pages based on the page index.

methods.name: welcomePage
methods.description: Constructs the welcome page with security notice and introduction.

methods.name: connectionPage
methods.description: Builds the connection setup page with options for local or remote Gateway.

methods.name: gatewayDiscoverySection
methods.description: Displays nearby gateways discovered on the network with refresh capability.

methods.name: advancedConnectionSection
methods.description: Provides advanced connection options including transport, URL, SSH settings.

methods.name: permissionsPage
methods.description: Page requesting macOS permissions needed by OpenClaw.

methods.name: cliPage
methods.description: Instructions and controls for installing the CLI required for local mode.

methods.name: workspacePage
methods.description: Setup page for configuring the agent workspace directory.

methods.name: onboardingChatPage
methods.description: Page containing a dedicated onboarding chat interface with the agent.

methods.name: readyPage
methods.description: Final step page indicating setup completion and feature highlights.

methods.name: skillsOverview
methods.description: Displays report of installed or available skills for the agent.

methods.name: probeRemoteConnection
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous check to verify remote gateway connection and authentication.
